name: The Vampire Hunter
source:
In this visual novel, you will face a vampire hunter in the night.

The way you deal with him is the key to discovering some truths about yourself. The element of surprise will catch you off guard many times during your journey. It comes from everywhere, even from your own character. That’s why, be alert, get ready and feel the flow.

YOU WILL BE HUNTED OR BECOME THE HUNTER?

[From [url=https://thunderliz.itch.io/the-vampire-hunter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你将在夜间面对吸血鬼猎人。

你与他相处的方式是发现一些关于你自己的真相的关键。在旅途中，惊喜的元素会让你多次措手不及。它来自四面八方，甚至来自你自己的性格。这就是为什么，要保持警惕，做好准备并感受流动。

你会被猎杀还是成为猎人？

[来自[url=https://thunderliz.itch.io/the-vampire-hunter]Itch.io[/url]]
